sn47.42:1.1: Catunnam bhikkhave satipaṭṭhānānam samudayañca atthagamañca desissāmi || taṃ suṇātha || || Ko ca bhikkhave kāyassa samudayo || || Āhārasamudayā kāyassa samudayo || āhāranirodhā kāyassa atthagamo || || Phassasamudayā vedanānaṃ samudayo || phassanirodhā vedanānam atthagamo || || Nāmarūpasamudayā cittassa samudayo || nāmarūpanirodhā cittassa atthagamo || || Manasikārasamudayā dhammānam samudayo || manasikāranirodhā dhammānam atthagamo ti || ||
